subject: literacy
concept: Addressing counterarguments and alternative interpretations within a literary thesis
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a thesis to its strongest plausible counter-interpretation
exercise.abstract: Student writes a paragraph acknowledging and responding to a genuine counterargument to their thesis

assessment.mastery_threshold: paragraph presents a genuine, strong counterargument and a substantive response, not a weak strawman
misconception_flags: presents an easily dismissed counterargument instead of the strongest real alternative interpretation

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
